name: Camp Farwell
description_short: Overnight camp offering 2-, 3-, 4- and 7-week sessions plus one-week "Rookie Week" sessions for the 2027 summer. Horseback riding can be added for an extra fee, and custom sessions are available on request.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: Prices shown are base tuition. Horseback riding costs extra: for example, $600–$2,000 on a 2-week session, up to $7,000 on the 7-week session, and $300 on Rookie Week.
International campers pay an extra $400 (covers Boston Logan airport transfer, medical insurance and linens).
Enrollment is limited in the Two Week and Rookie Week sessions.
Private lessons cost extra (riding $110/30 min, tennis and swimming $75/30 min) and are not offered the weeks of July 18 and August 8.
Page footer says 'Copyright © 2021' and the navigation mentions the 2026 staff, but the session dates and prices are clearly for 2027.
Rookie Week prices are labeled 'Special introductory tuition'.
